versions.changelog:
Initial release of find-skills skill.

- Introduces a prioritized flow for discovering and installing skills based on user intent.
- Automatically prefers skillhub (optimized for Chinese users) with transparent fallback to clawhub.
- Clearly presents available skill options, including name, description, source, and installation command.
- Ensures installation workflow is user-friendly and highlights risks when installing new skills.
- Handles cases where no relevant skill is found by offering general help or custom skill creation.
